title: ArcRanks actual crafted quantity fix, 2026-10-17
assumptions: Bounded sensitivity for one assigned rare bread quest at Caesar, not a forecast or total server income. Low/base/high: 1 bread in one click / 4 bread in one Shift click / 4 bread in separate clicks. Existing quantity target is 4, without rank/rare target scaling.

Each scenario takes at most one active hour in one day; 1/1/4 clicks per hour, 1/4/4 actual bread. Participants 1/5/20 are assumptions and all possess the selected frozen quest; ordinary selection probability is not inferred.
Before quest completion counts 0/0/1; after 0/1/1. At most one payout for this assignment per UTC day. Same actions produce the same bread; no items are issued by this fix.
Conservative rare Caesar reward uses existing 150 vault x 350% = 525 vault and 3 tokens. Normal payouts and all rank reward scales are unchanged; do not add normal and rare variants of one quest.

Daily catalog currently specifies 2 rare quests and 6..21 assignments. Existing assignments and reward idempotency are unchanged. Actual additional completions and source-specific ranks income are unknown.
EconomyShopGUI SELL and contract migration are unchanged; no SELL proceeds, SHADOW flows, other jobs, or item-to-money conversion are added here.

Read-only ledger window 1791637661343..1792242461344 has 12470 records, 66635 operations, 27 players. Ranks source: 30681 vault/210 operations/24 players, 47 tokens/32 operations/15 players. No craft-specific attribution; activity buckets are not session time.
